mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_summary ( tracking_number, booking_id, current_status, current_unlocode, current_voyage_number, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, estimated_arrival, delivered_at, misrouted, last_event_at, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{currentStatus}, #{currentUnlocode}, #{currentVoyageNumber}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{estimatedArrival}, #{deliveredAt}, #{misrouted}, #{lastEventAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tracking_summary ORDER BY updated_at DESC, tracking_number ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking_summary SET current_status = #{currentStatus}, current_unlocode = #{currentUnlocode}, current_voyage_number = #{currentVoyageNumber}, misrouted = #{misrouted}, last_event_at = #{lastEventAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
UPDATE tracking_summary SET delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
